title: 34 Years Ago, Shonen Jump’s Coolest Anime Began By Killing Its Hero
content: Yu Yu Hakusho began airing on October 10th, 1992, in Japan, and since then, its legacy as one of the greatest Shonen Jump series remains unmatched. Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazines have dominated the anime and manga industry for several decades now.

title: Vinland Saga Fans Are Getting a Perfect Replacement in 2027
content: It’s been over a year since the Vinland Saga manga reached its conclusion, and with the anime’s future uncertain, it’s obvious fans need a perfect replacement to keep them busy. Based on Makoto Yukimara’s manga, WIT Studio released the first season of the anime in 2019, but it was then handed over to MAPPA.

title: 2 Years Ago, Dragon Ball Creator’s Final Project Marked the End of an Era
content: As Akira Toriyama’s final project, Dragon Ball Daima received countless praises from fans who enjoyed a brand-new adventure of Goku and his friends. The 20-episode anime series was released last year to commemorate Dragon Ball ’s 40th anniversary.

title: 'Houseki no Kuni' Creator Launches New Manga
content: The December 2026 issue of Monthly Afternoon magazine announced on Friday that manga creator Haruko Ichikawa will launch a new sci-fi manga, titled Cosmic Mimimi , in the magazine next issue, scheduled for a November 25 release.
